- HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0007 · AVOID — In general, avoid implementing other controls that perform the same functions as edit menu items · Edit menus > Best practices ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/edit-menus))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0001 · SHOULD — Prefer the system-provided edit menu · Edit menus > Best practices ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/edit-menus))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0002 · SHOULD — Let people reveal an edit menu using the system-defined interactions they already know · Edit menus > Best practices ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/edit-menus))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0003 · SHOULD — Offer commands that are relevant in the current context, removing or dimming commands that don’t apply · Edit menus > Best practices ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/edit-menus))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0004 · SHOULD — Support undo and redo when possible · Edit menus > Best practices ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/edit-menus))
- HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0005 · SHOULD — Create short labels for custom commands · Edit menus > Content ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/edit-menus))
